content.subject: Proposed changes to the agreement
content.body:
Hi, I have reviewed the agreement and would like to suggest a couple of small updates before we proceed.

- Regarding the relevant clause on termination, the agreement permits the client to end the contract immediately without notice and without payment, leaving you without an equivalent right. I propose that the Client may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon providing 30 days prior written notice to the Contractor, and shall pay for all Services performed and expenses incurred up to the effective date of termination.

- Regarding the relevant clause on intellectual property, ownership of your work passes to the client upon delivery prior to payment, leaving you unprotected if payment is not made. I propose that all intellectual property rights in each Deliverable shall transfer to the Client upon receipt of full payment of the applicable fees.

Thank you, and I look forward to signing soon.
